local-full. (1) Function: predict() = max under ranking nu>mu>va>vu>ri>ve agrees with the model on 200/200 held-out inputs for each of seeds 11, 12, 13, 14 (V0001-V0004). (2) No inert head: resample-ablating single heads leaves 0.43 (1.1), 0.62 (0.1), 0.69 (1.0), 0.73 (0.0) (E0010); joint mean-ablation of both layer-0 heads leaves 0.34 (E0009, refuted my 'L0 dispensable' prediction). (3) Layer-1 heads both attend from the last position to the rank-maximum whatever it is (vu at pos 2: 1.0 0.96, 1.1 0.83; E0011) and write 3.2 and 4.7 logit-diff units directly, layer-0 heads ~0.1-0.2 (E0012, exploratory); total direct head write is 8.3 of 36.3, the rest comes via the MLPs. Patching whole-layer outputs: mlp0 0.78, mlp1 0.75, attn0 0.65, attn1 0.89 (E0014, E0015; my per-position metric paths did not exist, so both predictions scored inconclusive - the per-position questions stay open). (4) After layer 0 the answer is already top-1 on the median input but weak (logit diff 1.5 vs 36.3 final, prob 0.42; E0013 exploratory). (5) Layer-0 heads feed layer-1 heads through VALUES (0.18 and 0.19; E0018, refuted my <=0.1 prediction), not queries (0.01-0.02; E0017) or keys (0.02-0.06; E0016 exploratory). (6) Circuit size: full model 6/6 passes thresholds but sufficiency has no null (V0001, status not-verified for that structural reason). Dropping 0.0 alone: rest keeps 0.73 of metric, accuracy 1.0 (V0002, verified). Dropping 1.0 alone: 0.71, accuracy 0.98 (V0003, verified). Dropping both 0.0 and 1.0: 0.52, accuracy 0.855, fails sufficiency (V0004). So the heads are partially redundant in pairs but each carries ~27-30% of the margin; none is inert.
H1 supported: predict() agrees with the model on 800/800 held-out inputs across four unused seeds (V0001-V0004).
